RESOLUTION EVIDENCE. Superseded by story 0d87-6e23-a894-4d0a (mythopoeic-swirly-leafbird),
which is now CLOSED, with its fix merged to main as bd8dc713f via Gerrit change 1021
(LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 / CI run 30510156790 SUCCESS).

This ticket's own acceptance criteria are evidence-recording, and each is satisfied by its
description as filed:
  1. All seven instances with ORIGINAL criterion text, the text each contradicts, and the
     owning ticket -- recorded under "Why the plans were not completeable".
  2. The four failure classes A/B/C/D each named with a worked example -- same section,
     one subsection per class.
  3. The evidence the plans PASSED -- recorded in "Reproduction Steps": epic 1386's signed
     manifest showing plan-review: PASS / blocking: 0 / advisory: 11.
  4. The G3 observation (exists, routes at container scope, ran, did not flag the class-D
     gap), recorded as observation only with no diagnosis -- in the class-D subsection.
  5. The late-detection cost per instance and the stale-material re-review cost -- recorded
     under "Cost of late detection".
  6. No plan-review prompt, criterion, routing entry or detector was changed UNDER THIS
     TICKET. Verified: `git log gerrit/main --grep=e7be-b985-c344-46f7` returns no commits.
     Every code change landed under story 0d87's trailer instead.

What the superseding story actually fixed, for the record:
  - Added the `ac-satisfiability` criterion (1-TURN, facet coherence, advisory) owning the
    joint-satisfiability question no criterion owned -- the classes A/B/C gap. It is built on
    a generic primitive (an AC quantifies over a set; something else in the same description
    excepts a member) rather than this episode's subject vocabulary, so it generalises beyond
    the migration that motivated it.
  - Fixed the class-D cause: G3's "flag an absence only if NO sibling covers it" test was
    undischargeable because the sibling roster carried ids and titles only. The roster now
    carries each child's acceptance criteria, from a single shared builder used by all three
    callers, and rides the cached prefix so the richer roster does not cost tokens quadratic
    in child count.
  - G3's posture and threshold were deliberately left unchanged; revisiting them was scoped
    to await dogfooding data from this change.
